# UI/UX Pro Max Standards (OptiSense HMI)

- Visuals must feel like an ABB control room: deep navy base, layered cards, subtle noise texture, minimal gloss.
- Use strong typographic hierarchy: Space Grotesk for headings, Inter for body, JetBrains Mono for values.
- Motion should be meaningful: staggered content, smooth list reorders, drawer slides, modal scale-in.
- Use ISA severity colors exactly; critical states get a subtle glow.
- Buttons must show clear hover/active states with teal accents; no default focus rings.
- Favor dense, information-rich layouts with clear grouping and status chips.
- Avoid generic SaaS visuals; keep it industrial and operational.
